TOMORROW:

Join us for Conversations with Cori in Northwoods!

Today’s community conversation was great—come join us tomorrow afternoon for another discussion with our neighbors about the issues we’re facing here in St. Louis.

We’ll meet at Northwoods City Park to talk about how we'll shape our community’s future together. Can’t wait to see you there!

Thank you so much to everyone who joined us for Conversations with Cori this morning!

I had a great time at the Daily Drip talking with neighbors about how to fight back against attacks on our voting rights, make real progress on tornado recovery, and other issues our community is facing.

For those of you who couldn’t make it, join us tomorrow afternoon in Northwoods for the next Conversations with Cori!

This is how we’ll make real change: coming together across St. Louis to build our movemen

Welcome to a healthier you!

I had so much fun at the last stop of yesterday’s small business tour with owners Brandace and Jada.

B-Juiced brings delicious smoothies, fresh juices, and food to Ferguson. I’m so happy to see them supporting healthy living in Ferguson through high-quality, nutritious ingredients and thoughtfully developed recipes.

I had a great time paying a visit to Gretchen Jones, owner of MO Family Transportation!

When the tornado hit last year, this Black-woman-owned business was one of the first to answer the call, supporting the clean-up effort with their dump truck services.

When we support local small businesses, we support our neighbors who show up when our community needs them most.

Yesterday, I had the honor of visiting Freedom Day Center in North County, an adult daycare providing transportation, delicious meals, and activities for older adults.

This small business is more than just a great place to spend the day—as one guest told me, they love Freedom Day because “it’s a family.”

I had a great time meeting Tink Calvin, owner of Family Haven Event Center in Dellwood.

Tink started Family Haven to provide a beautiful and affordable space where families can gather to create memories.

I’m always proud to see our North County small businesses thrive!

Where: 2800 N 14th St, St. Louis, MO 63107

TOMORROW:

Join us for Conversations with Cori!

Today, I’m seeing a lot of dissatisfaction and disappointment online.

If you’re feeling that way, come turn it into action. I’m thankful to see so much support for our movement to protect, build, and transform St. Louis, but it counts for nothing if we don’t organize.

Come join us tomorrow at The Daily Drip Coffee Cafe in Old North St. Louis to have a real conversation with community members about the issues that St. Louis is facing, our people-

I had a wonderful time visiting Koffee Ko in Jennings and experiencing the warm, welcoming space they’ve created for the community to gather and connect. Black-owned small businesses like Koffee Ko play a vital role in helping our community thrive.

In 2023, Koffee Ko became the first Black-woman-owned coffee shop in Jennings.

Now, they’ve opened a second location in the Grove! I'm proud to support this local small business, and excited to see them grow.

It was a pleasure to pay a visit to Raggedy Ann 'n Andy Daycare in The Ville and spend the morning with the next generation of St. Louisans.

Like so many small businesses in North City, Raggedy Ann 'n Andy needs our support after the tornado.

It was heartbreaking to hear about the challenges that they and their neighbors have been experiencing after last year’s disaster while they’ve been hard at work doing an excellent job to care of our kids and provide assistance to St. Louis families.

I had a great time today at the new Family Care Health Centers location’s Grand Opening in Dutchtown, made possible by ARPA funding.

Bringing affordable and accessible primary health care is a vital part of making sure that families in Dutchtown can thrive.

WHERE: 4600 Oakridge Blvd, St. Louis, MO, 63121
RSVP HERE: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

SUNDAY MAY 24TH:

Come talk with Cori, Errol, and our North County community about the issues on your mind this election.

We’ll meet at the park behind Northwoods City Hall to have conversations with neighbors about how we can work together to protect, build, and transform the St. Louis area.

When: This Saturday, May 23rd, from 10 to 11:30 AM  
Where: 2800 N 14th St, St. Louis, MO 63107
RSVP Here:
mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

SATURDAY MAY 23RD:

Join Cori Bush for coffee and conversation on Saturday!

Come talk with Cori and community members about the issues affecting our neighbors and support a local Black-owned business at the same time!

We’ll meet at The Daily Drip Coffee Cafe and invite St. Louisans to share your ideas for shaping our future together.
RSVP HERE: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…
